newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA PANK SHORT-TERM RATING LC-2.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA PANK SHORT-TERM RATING LC-2.

text.p: Thomson Bankwatch assigned Tallinna Pank A short-term local currency rating of LC-2, the rating agency said on Monday.
"Bankwatch assigned ratings reflect Tallinna's current generally satisfactory condition and our belief that it will continue developing as a major commercial bank in the Baltics," the agency said.
"The bank's profitability remains strong with return ratios remaining high and the outlook favourable," it added.
"Liquidity reflects general tight market conditions although Tallinna has access to international debt markets recently completing its syndicated loan for three years," it added.
The bank is going to take a syndicated loan of 240 million kroons, which it hopes to sign at the end of April.
Free capital was considered insufficient because of high investments in fixed assets but existing capital augmentation plans should boost the level of free capital, the agency said.
Thomson assigned Estonia's leading bank, Hansapan, a short-term local currency rating of LC-1 last week.
The rating agency said earlier it will assign ratings to other Estonian top banks and leading Latvian bank Parex.
